cwe_content.cwe: CWE-22,Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

candidate.Reason: The 'sourcename' parameter is used directly without path traversal validation when creating the target file. An attacker could provide a filename with '../' sequences to write files outside the intended directory.
The 'newname' parameter is used directly without path traversal validation when creating the new file path. An attacker could provide a name with '../' sequences to move files to arbitrary locations.

The 'name' parameter is used directly without path traversal validation when creating a new directory. An attacker could provide a name with '../' sequences to create directories outside the intended location.

The 'name' parameter is used directly without path traversal validation when creating a new file. An attacker could provide a name with '../' sequences to create files outside the intended directory. The mkdirs() call on the parent file could create arbitrary directory structures.
